jobs.title: Newsroom Innovation Product Manager
jobs.location: NSW - SHS 2 Holt Street Surry Hills
jobs.description:
What's the role?

News Corp Australia is seeking an experienced, visionary National Newsroom Innovation Product Manager to drive our editorial R&D agenda.

Sitting at the intersection of emerging technology and high-impact journalism, you will lead the discovery, rapid prototyping, and de-risking of ground-breaking AI solutions. Working alongside our editorial and technical leaders, you will set the benchmark for ethical, scalable, and value-accretive AI tooling across the country’s largest newsrooms.

As a leader of our Newsroom Innovation stream, you will guide ideas from exploratory R&D to validated proof-of-concepts ready for live newsroom adoption.

You will lead our dedicated Innovation squad (including AI Product Manager, Data Scientist and AI / Python Developer, and Editorial specialists) in solving complex, high-velocity editorial challenges. In addition to driving front-end discovery, you will oversee the transition of validated prototypes to the AI Product Manager, ensuring a seamless handover into the live production environment.

This role can be based in any of our head offices across NSW, VIC, SA and QLD (2 days can be worked from home)

Key responsibilities

- Partner with editorial leadership, engineering, and prompt design to translate high-level business and editorial challenges into a concrete, prioritised R&D product roadmap (rolling 8-week and full financial year).
- Lead the end-to-end innovation lifecycle, validating new AI capabilities, LLMs, and emerging technologies through agile prototyping and clear business-case definition.
- Serve as the product authority on model accuracy, hallucination management, and output validation, ensuring every prototype upholds News Corp Australia’s rigorous standards of journalistic integrity.
- Maintain strategic oversight of the complete AI product pipeline. Partner with the AI Product Manager to manage smooth handovers of production-ready prototypes into the BAU maintenance and scaling lifecycle.
- Contribute and produce crisp technical charters, evaluation frameworks, and product briefs that define our technical philosophy and support collaboration with national editorial heads and global technology partners.
- Remove technical and operational blockers across teams, fostering a newsroom-paced delivery culture that balances speed with enterprise-grade reliability.
- Establish clear R&D metrics and leadindicator KPIs to measure prototype velocity, editorial feasibility, and projected business value.

Who are you?

- Proven track record in product management leading 0to-1 innovation, rapid prototyping, or R&D initiatives within media, digital publishing, or high-pace tech environments.
- Strong practical understanding of the modern generative AI landscape, LLM architectures, fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic systems, and prompt evaluation.
- Ability to thrive in a high-velocity, real-time news ecosystem that moves significantly faster than conventional software release cycles.
- Exceptional attention to detail with experience building systematic validation frameworks to test model performance, bias, and output safety.
- High-level gravitas with the ability to bridge conversations between data scientists/prompt engineers and newsroom executives.
- Demonstrated capability in guiding and developing other product professionals, setting high standards for documentation and product craft.

What we offer

- High-profile, strategic leadership role within News Corp Australia’s flagship AI team, with enterprise-wide impact.
- Flexible hybrid working arrangements across our major Australian offices.
- Competitive executive remuneration package with career growth across our national and global networks.
- The opportunity to shape how generative AI elevates world-class journalism.

Why News Corp Australia
Join a culture where innovation is our operating rhythm. You’ll work on a diverse portfolio of Australia’s most loved brands and play a pivotal role in leading the technological shift in how we create commercial content. Our vibrant, hybrid work environment and dynamic, values-driven culture empowers you to push boundaries, collaborate as one unified team, and make a positive, measurable impact for all Australians.

News Extras Benefits is a commitment to our people for their valued contribution to News, our audiences, clients and communities.

Our benefits include:

- Exclusively ours - Access to publications and products from across the News Corp family

- Perks & discounts - Exclusive offers across a range of products and services that deliver genuine cost savings and benefits

- Health & wellbeing - Advice, support and facilities for healthy minds and bodies (including an onsite gym at our Adelaide, Brisbane & Sydney offices)

- Time off - News offers a range of leave options to support your personal needs and moments that matter in life: Parental leave, Birthday leave, Volunteer leave, Career break and Compassionate leave.

- Financial wellbeing - Support on making the most of your money

In addition to our perks and benefits, employees have access to a number of initiatives and programs that support their wellbeing and professional growth, such as:

- Helping you grow - Access tailored development opportunities, including leadership programs, to cultivate your skills and support your career

- Giving back - Make a difference to our communities through volunteer opportunities and company-organised charity drives

- Workplace Inclusion and facilities – Engage with your passions through various employee-resource groups and accessibility to multi-faith quiet rooms & parents’ rooms

Who are we?
News Corp Australia is the nation’s most influential media organisation, operating more than 150 household-name brands across print, digital, and multimedia. We lead the way in travel, fashion, food, health, homes, and lifestyle, and we are the largest publisher across print and digital, reaching more than 16 million Australians each month.
What’s next?
Apply now or for more information on careers at News Corp Australia visit www.newscorpaustralia.com/careers

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
Diversity strengthens our national teams and newsroom as we seek to tell stories that represent the communities of Australia. Our people make us unique, and so we are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, disability or gender identity. Applicants of diverse backgrounds are encouraged to apply!

jobs.title: Senior Manager Product Strategy
jobs.location: NSW - SHS 2 Holt Street Surry Hills
jobs.description:
What's the role?
Join News Corp Australia, shaping the digital future of Australia’s most loved lifestyle brands, including Taste, Australian Best Recipes, Escape, and Body + Soul.

As the Senior Manager - Product Strategy, you will drive the product strategy and delivery that elevates our digital storytelling. Your core purpose is to spearhead innovative initiatives that captivate audiences, unlock new revenue streams, and cement our brands as market leaders in the lifestyle space.

Responsibilities

- Define and own the quarterly product vision, ensuring every initiative actively accelerates audience growth, user engagement, and revenue.
- Lead product planning by crafting comprehensive briefs, user stories, and success metrics, while acting as the agile problem-solver to unblock friction.
- Partner closely with editorial and commercial teams to elevate digital storytelling while seamlessly integrating powerful monetisation opportunities.
- Work side-by-side with tech teams and designers to translate complex requirements into exceptional, high-quality user experiences.
- Analyse audience behavior, core media metrics, and competitor trends to uncover, pitch, and execute high-impact growth opportunities.
- Proactively brainstorm, test, and validate new product concepts, utilising post-launch performance KPIs for relentless, iterative optimisation.

Who are you?
- You're a digital media expert. You bring proven digital product management experience, ideally in publishing or media, with a powerful track record of driving measurable audience and revenue growth.

- You possess a deep understanding of user behavior and content consumption patterns, easily translating these insights into practical, engaging product solutions.

- You effortlessly balance audience needs with business objectives, identifying smart ways to integrate commercial strategies without compromising the user experience.

- You excel at bridging the gap between editorial, commercial, technical, and marketing teams, translating complex needs into actionable plans while keeping everyone aligned.

- You have strong analytical skills, confidently interpreting complex data sets and market trends to build actionable, performance-backed product roadmaps.

- You are a proactive innovator with exceptional communication skills, capable of managing multiple initiatives and influencing stakeholders at all levels.
